verdict.rationale: The timeouts documentation states one billing rule: under the `return-partial` deadline policy, a request with no usable result fails without a charge. That covers only one narrow failure scenario. missing for 10: billing treatment of general failed requests (e.g. 4xx/5xx errors), blocked/anti-bot or opted-out sites, empty-result scrapes or crawls, a dedicated billing/credits policy page, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether failed, blocked, or empty-result requests still consume my billing quota

citations.quote: If no usable result exists, fail without a charge.
